proposedchanges.title: Supreme Court Rejects Sidney Powell’s Final 2020 Election Challenge
proposedchanges.description_long: On March 1, 2021, the Supreme Court rejected Sidney Powell’s lawsuit challenging the 2020 election results in Arizona and Wisconsin. The supplied account described it as the final lawsuit in the effort to overturn the result. Powell had advanced claims that the source characterized as debunked conspiracy theories. The Court’s action ended this particular challenge. The linked reports do not provide the Court’s reasoning or a detailed procedural history, so the account should not infer why the justices acted or draw conclusions about other cases. Powell’s lawsuit followed Joe Biden’s victory and sought to challenge results in two states. The ruling resolved the case before the Court; it did not, by itself, resolve every legal dispute filed after the election.

evidencebasis: The packet and merged description identify Powell’s challenge, its Arizona and Wisconsin focus, and the March 1, 2021 rejection. The merged description says the Court’s reasoning is not provided. Both source URLs remain in source_urls.
notes: The existing medium and long cover the same action, but the long has a repeated legal-limit discussion. Remove its generic interpretation and source commentary, and replace the unrelated war metadata.

proposedchanges.title: Mike Pompeo Was Scheduled to Speak at Mar-a-Lago Fundraiser but Did Not Attend
proposedchanges.description_long: The Palm Beach County Republican Party scheduled its Lincoln Day fundraiser at Mar-a-Lago for April 17, 2021, with former Secretary of State Mike Pompeo announced as a featured speaker. The listed guests included Florida senators Marco Rubio and Rick Scott and other Republican officials. Contemporary reporting said Pompeo did not attend. The event record documents the fundraiser’s planned date and venue, Pompeo’s announced role, and the listed guests. It does not establish that Pompeo attended, that Donald Trump organized the dinner, or that the guests met privately with him.

evidencebasis: The packet identifies the planned April 17 fundraiser and scheduled speakers. The merged medium states that contemporary reporting said Pompeo did not attend and that the schedule does not establish Trump organized it. The current source URLs are retained.
notes: Update the title to reflect the no-show documented in the description. Remove speculative networking language and clear the unsupported category.
